description: This PHP class defines the entity 'DisplayFieldGroup' used in the OrangeHRM system. It models a database table 'ohrm_display_field_group' with properties for ID, associated report group, name, list flag, and related display fields. The class includes ORM mappings and accessor methods.

classes.name: DisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing the 'ohrm_display_field_group' table, with properties for ID, report group, name, list flag, and associated display fields.

methods.name: getId

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the display field group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field group.

methods.name: isList

methods.name: setIsList
methods.description: Sets whether the display field group is a list.
